title: Slightly Expired Caramel
description: Joke resource pack inspired by a comment in a reddit post calling copper caramel.
body:
**This should work on every version with copper items but it was made for 1.20.1 specifically and I'm not planning on updating it frequently.**

## What does this do?
Changes all names that have copper inside them to funny things such as **"Slightly Expired Cut Caramel Stairs Coated with Honey"** and also swaps out their textures to some more vibrant and some more ugly textures with the copper bar also having a drip animation.![Caramel Ingot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/31a7e54020672787d63abf5bd6c2be6c08111d51.gif)

## Why?
Because I saw a comment saying they called copper caramel in [**this post**](https://www.reddit.com/r/PhoenixSC/comments/1gqyinw/what_do_you_call_copper/) and thought it would be a good idea to make a resource pack for it.


![Image of the comment](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a0e4c84737875fb016d6ca0dbf792be505f3d6b0.png)
